title: AORT I4 - controlled failure injection event (PROVISIONAL, NOT FROZEN)
description: Ground truth for one controlled failure: what was injected, into which component, when it started and when it was reverted. Produced by infrastructure/injection. This is the label source for the experiment dataset (Phase 6) and for supervised learning (Phase 7) - a scenario's effect can only be learned if the moment it started and ended is recorded independently of the telemetry it perturbs. Proposed by Owner B for joint review with Owner A, who owns scenario semantics.

injection_id.description: UUID4 shared by the start and end events of one injection.

phase.description: start: the failure is now active. end: it has been reverted and the component restored. failed: the injection itself could not be applied, so no failure was active.

scenario.description: service_stop: process/container gone. service_pause: frozen but not lost, so no data loss. cpu_throttle: resource exhaustion. backup_stop: backups stop, so RPO degrades while the service still serves traffic.

component_id.description: Target component. fineract and postgres match the I1 telemetry vocabulary; backup is the ledger backup sidecar, which I1 currently reports as signals on postgres - reconciling this is part of the open joint decision on stable component identity.

parameters.description: Scenario parameters as strings, e.g. {"cpus": "0.2"}. Empty when the scenario takes none.

at.description: UTC, millisecond precision. Start and end timestamps bound the window in which telemetry should show impact.

error.description: Why the injection failed; null for start and end events.
